description_en: Places an order for a fixed-price premium domain name. If the call is successful, the payment is automatically deducted from your Alibaba Cloud account balance
description_zh: 一口价严选域名商品下单接口，调用成功会自动从阿里云账户余额进行扣款
kebab_example: aliyun domain create-fixed-price-selected-order --domain-name example.com --code '无' --source partnername --contact-id 11935401 --expected-price 20.0 --api-version 2018-02-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFixedPriceSelectedOrder

parameters.help_en: The fixed-price premium domain name that you want to purchase
parameters.help_zh: 想要购买的一口价严选域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The extension field. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: code

parameters.help_en: The order source. This parameter is optional. You can set this parameter to the name of the caller
parameters.help_zh: 订单来源，非必填，可以填入调用方名称
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The ID of a verified registrant profile. After the domain name transaction is completed, the domain name ownership is transferred to this verified domain name registrant profile. You can log on to https://dc.console.aliyun.com/next/index#/info-stencil/infoStencil to query or create a verified registrant profile
parameters.help_zh: 已实名的联系人模板ID，域名交易成功后将过户至该已实名认证的域名信息模板下。可登录https://dc.console.aliyun.com/next/index#/info-stencil/infoStencil查询或创建已实名的信息模板
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.help_en: The expected purchase price. Set this parameter to the value of the Price field returned by the CheckSelectedDomainStatus operation. This parameter prevents discrepancies between the price returned by the price query operation and the actual selling price at the time of order placement, which may cause unexpected charges
parameters.help_zh: 期望购买价格。该价格应为CheckSelectedDomainStatus接口查询出的Price字段。用于防止调用询价接口时的域名价格与域名下单时实际售卖价格不一致，造成扣款不符合客户预期的问题
parameters.name: expected_price
